motion.name: card-border
motion.purpose: Subtle card hover; removed under reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary preview action when a route exists.
components.css: .ds-primary {font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #203140; border-radius:8px; min-height:44px; color:#edf2fc; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none;background:var(--accent, #365bff);color:white;border-color:#4d6bff;} .ds-primary:hover {background:#476aff;border-color:#7690ff;} .ds-primary:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #9ebaff; outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered secondary action; unavailable actions retain an honest disabled state.
components.css: .ds-secondary {font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #203140; border-radius:8px; min-height:44px; color:#edf2fc; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none;background:#14212e;} .ds-secondary:hover:enabled {background:#1b2b3d;border-color:#3c5270;} .ds-secondary:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #9ebaff; outline-offset:4px;} .ds-secondary:disabled {cursor:not-allowed;color:#8394ad;opacity:.65;}

components.name: Search
components.description: Inset project search with an SVG line icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 21l-5-5M18 10a8 8 0 1 1-16 0 8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/></svg><input aria-label="Search projects" placeholder="Search projects…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 14px;min-height:46px;border:1px solid #203140;border-radius:9px;background:#14212d;color:var(--muted,#94a8c2);} .ds-search svg {width:21px;height:21px;} .ds-search input {font:400 14px/1.45 Inter,sans-serif;width:100%;min-width:0;background:none;border:0;color:#edf2fc;padding:10px 0;caret-color:#a5bdff;} .ds-search input::placeholder {color:#94a8c2;} .ds-search input:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #9ebaff;outline-offset:0;}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Quiet main navigation with a blue selected surface.
components.css: .ds-nav {display:grid;gap:8px;background:#0c1721;padding:18px;} .ds-nav button {font: 400 14px/1.45 Inter, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #203140; border-radius:8px; min-height:44px; color:#edf2fc; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none;justify-content:flex-start;border-color:transparent;background:transparent;color:#bfcef0;font-size:16px;padding:14px 20px;min-height:54px;} .ds-nav button[aria-current] {background:#10213c;border-left:1px solid #5678ff;color:#b8d4ff;} .ds-nav button:hover {background:#1b2b3d;border-color:#3c5270;} .ds-nav button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #9ebaff; outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Flat full-width project surface with state explicitly named.
components.css: .ds-card {font:400 14px/1.45 Inter,sans-serif;color:#edf2fc;padding:14px 20px 13px;border:1px solid #1d2f3d;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(112deg,#0d1a24,#0d1922);transition:border-color 160ms ease-out;min-width:0;} .ds-card:hover {border-color:#2b4359;} .ds-card:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #9ebaff; outline-offset:4px;} .ds-card h2 {margin:0;padding-bottom:11px;border-bottom:1px solid #1b2e3c;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.015em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;} .ds-card h2 span {font-size:12px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;color:#94a8c2;margin-left:16px;} .ds-card p {margin:12px 0 0;color:#94a8c2;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-card {transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A quiet, dark workspace follows the approved rootlane-ui-reference.png: blue-black surfaces, restrained blue actions, and compact project rows. The shipped React interface, ordinary CSS, local Inter font, and inline SVG icons are the visual source of truth.

Density supports scanning real projects and runtime observations. Color, labels, and disabled controls communicate what the backend knows; they never imply fictional agent activity or verified preview readiness.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black tonal surfaces with fine dividing borders.
Compact, full-width project rows with inline expansion.
Local Inter typography and consistent SVG line icons.
Explicit status text alongside colored dots.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Green means verified readiness or connection. Registered agents, observed listeners, and published routes use their explicit labels and quieter status colors.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use the shipped local Inter font for headings, interface text, and shortcut labels; preserve its tabular numerals and cv11 features.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and fine borders for the workspace; reserve the shipped shadow for the floating More menu.

dos: Do preserve explicit state labels alongside status dots.
Do keep project details collapsed initially and expand them inline.
Do use the existing local font and SVG icon vocabulary.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and honest disabled controls.
Do allow names, paths, and URLs to wrap on narrow screens.
donts: Don't promote Registered to active agent behavior, Listening to Ready, or Published to verified Available.
Don't enable folder, preview, or logs controls without the corresponding capability.
Don't add system-stat cards, account chrome, or editable Settings to this approved surface.
Don't add a UI dependency to reproduce patterns already expressed in ordinary CSS.
